title: Open transport of the normalized comparison into derived pullback
statement: Let f:X to S, f prime:X prime to S prime, g:S prime to S and g prime:X prime to X form a cartesian square [def-pc-base-change] of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with the chosen derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Choose opens V in S and V prime in S prime satisfying V prime contained in the inverse image of V. Put U=f inverse V and U prime=f prime inverse V prime. Let j:U prime to U commute with the open inclusions and g prime, and suppose the restricted square j,f prime restricted,f restricted,g.resLE is cartesian. Fix only K on X, a K-flat complex P representing K and a K-flat complex Q representing its exact open restriction, together with the two representing derived isomorphisms and invertible pinned pullback counits. At z in U prime and integer i let F0,F be the additive forgetful functors, H0,H exact derived stalk cohomology, R exact derived restriction on X prime, and theta the canonical restricted identity coefficient of Lg prime star K. There exist a natural isomorphism nu:R followed by H0 followed by F0 to H followed by F, and an additive isomorphism l between the sources of the two comparisonIntoPullback maps [lem-pc-stalk-comparison-pullback-naturality], such that restricted comparisonIntoPullback followed by H0 of Lj star a then theta, followed by nu at Lg prime star K, equals l followed by original comparisonIntoPullback followed by H of Lg prime star e. There is no target K prime, coefficient phi, target complex, or coordinate chain map in this statement. Exact derived restriction is [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps], theta is constructed using [def-pc-single-complex-open-restriction-data], and exact derived stalk cohomology is [lem-pc-stalk-comparison-source-transport]. The tensor cohomology model in comparisonIntoPullback is [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model], with the actual stalk rings and structure maps from [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition].

proof.text: Construct nu by the explicit additive derived-stalk open restriction isomorphism. Put P0 equal to actual termwise restriction. The canonical termwise comparison lemma supplies K-flatness of P0, invertibility of its pinned counit, and the normalized comparison square for P and P0 with K=Q(P).

Compose the naturality equations of the six factors of the restricted identity coefficient using a proved generic categorical lemma. Its naturality in e, together with naturality of nu, transports the canonical comparison square from Q(P) to K. Put E=the canonical localization factor for P0 followed by restriction(e), and b=a followed by E inverse. Thus b is a derived isomorphism Q(Q) to Q(P0).

Apply exists_comparisonSourceIso and comparisonIntoPullback_naturality to b inside the restricted square. Extend the unique tensor-algebra source isomorphism to the final stalk ring and forget scalars to get d. Postcompose its square with H0 of Lj(E) then the restricted identity coefficient; b then E equals a. Compose this square with the preceding canonical square and use functoriality and associativity. The required source isomorphism is d followed by l. This handles arbitrary Q,e,a without changing the given statement.

theorem exists_singleComplexOpen_normalized_transport
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (V : S.Opens) (V' : S'.Opens) (hV' : V' ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (j : (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').toScheme ⟶ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme)
    (hj : j ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι = (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').ι ≫ g')
    (sq₀ : IsPullback j (f' ∣_ V') (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V V' hV'))
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (Q : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ K)
    (a : DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q ≅
      (schemeOpenRestriction X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)
    (hP : P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat) (hQ : Q.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat)
    (hcP : IsIso ((counit g').app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P)))
    (hcQ : IsIso ((counit j).app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj Q)))
    (z : (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').toScheme) (i : ℤ) :
    let F₀ := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').toScheme.presheaf.stalk z)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (X'.presheaf.stalk z.val)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let H₀ := comparisonStalkCohomology (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').toScheme z i
    let H := comparisonStalkCohomology X' z.val i
    let R := (schemeOpenRestriction X' (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V')).mapDerivedCategory
    let θ := singleComplexRestrictedCoefficient g' K ((derivedPullback g').obj K) (𝟙 _)
      (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V') j hj
    ∃ (ν : R ⋙ H₀ ⋙ F₀ ≅ H ⋙ F)
      (l : F₀.obj ((Arrow.mk (comparisonIntoPullback (f ∣_ V) (f' ∣_ V')
        (g.resLE V V' hV') j sq₀ z Q hcQ i)).left) ≅
        F.obj ((Arrow.mk (comparisonIntoPullback f f' g g' sq z.val P hcP i)).left)),
      F₀.map (comparisonIntoPullback (f ∣_ V) (f' ∣_ V')
          (g.resLE V V' hV') j sq₀ z Q hcQ i ≫
        H₀.map ((derivedPullback j).map a.hom ≫ θ)) ≫
          ν.hom.app ((derivedPullback g').obj K) =
      l.hom ≫ F.map (comparisonIntoPullback f f' g g' sq z.val P hcP i ≫
        H.map ((derivedPullback g').map e.hom))
